    BRICKS PROPTECH INNOVATION

    A leading innovation center focused on innovative technologies in the

    Real Estate sector.

    BE PART OF
    SOMETHING BIG!

    BRICKS serves as the innovation arm for many of the influential owners, developers and operators of Real Estate in Israel, the US, the UK and Asia in order to give them access to leading and emerging Real Estate and Proptech technologies.

    We create perfect matches between our startups and our industry-leading partners, generating value for both.

    ​

    When needed, we mold the startups’ innovative technologies to suit our partners’ needs and help both parties co-create viable market-ready solutions

    Meet our Partners

    BRICKS collaborate with the most powerful leaders in the real estate industry and provides them with top emerging technologies to their doorstep - and even tailor solutions to their particular needs. We build a close relationship with each and every partner in order to gain an understanding of their needs and innovation interests. Our deep knowledge of each of our partner’s assets allows us to create the most effective matches between their group and promising technologies based on real market needs. 

    Bricks Value for Real Estate Firms & Conglomerates

    Find the technologies and startups that are shaping the future of real estate today

    • We help the world's largest and most influential RE firms solve big problems and unlock new opportunities.

    • We find best matches for the companies – for investment / JV / M&A / implementation of technologies.

    • We create value and accelerate growth for our the companies through access to innovative technologies and strategic insights into emerging trends.

    • We take advantage of our unrivalled access to deal-flow and global based network of partners, investors and relationships across Israel, Europe, the US and Asia.

    ​

    We welcome all real estate players, developers, realtors, architects, urban developers, tech companies and research institutions to join our partners and be part of the success.

    Pitch Practice Workshop

    Knowing how to pitch your startup is one of the most important skills you need to have in order to bring your startup to success. 

    ​

    Founders pitch all day! They pitch to investors, customers, employers and many more.
     

    This skill can be taught and improved to make you pitch with confidence, in excellence and leave an impact!

    ​

    That's why we established the BRICKS Pitch Practice Workshop.

    INVESTORS

    BRICKS Fund - Investing in the Future

    BRICKS Fund is an early-stage VC, which is focused on the startups and companies joining Bricks innovation hub.

    ​

    We are in the best position with our partners to evaluate and choose the best technologies who have the potential to make it big.

     

    We invest in core technologies and services across all stages of the PropTech industry, via two ways in parallel: 1. The BRICKS Fund and 2. Directly by our partners.

    ​

    BRICKS Fund has an extensive network of real estate players and advisors globally, which further supports the growth and scaling of portfolio companies, giving us through insight on investment opportunities.
